media.title: Avinash Bali murder case: MIDC police nabs two from Lucknow, one from Nallasopara
media.snippet: Six days after police informer and eye-witness of the infamous Keenan- Reuben murder case Avinash Solanki aka Bali (38) was brutally murdered, the MIDC police have nabbed three accused who are said to be involved in the murder and went absconding after killing Bali. Those arrested have been identified as Nilesh Shukla (38), Vanshbahadur Singh aka Jagga (48) and Ankit Dubey (19). While Shukla and Singh were nabbed from Lucknow, Dubey was picked up from his Nalasopara residence on Saturday.

media.title: Avinash Solanki murder: Before murder, deceased teased businessman about his sexual prowess, says police | The Indian Express
media.snippet: Shukla (38) and his driver Vanshbahadur Singh alias Jagga (48) were arrested in Lucknow on Saturday after being on the run for nearly a week. Shukla's bodyguard, 19-year-old Ankit Dubey, was also arrested from his home in Nallasopara the same day. The trio was produced in court on Sunday and remanded to police custody till August 1, the police said.

media.title: Avinash Solanki: Keenan-Reuben murder witness killed over money, woman: Cops
media.snippet: Avinash Solanki (in pic), alias Bali, the prime witness in the 2011 Keenan-Reuben murder case, was allegedly killed by his friend of 10 years over disputes related to money and a woman, the MIDC police have claimed in a chargesheet filed in a city court on Monday. Nilesh Shukla, a leader of a regional party, his driver Jagga and bodyguard Ankit Dubey have been arrested in connection with the crime that took place three months ago. Shukla is the main accused.

media.title: Bali's 'killer' held in Lucknow, changed looks to evade cops
media.snippet: F ive days after the body of Avinash Solanki, whose testimony had helped convict the four men who killed Keenan Santos and Reuben Fernandez in 2011, was found, his alleged murderer and business partner, Nilesh Shukla, was arrested in Lucknow on Saturday. Shukla's driver, Vanshbahadur Singh alias Jagga, 48, and bodyguard, Ankit Dubey, 19, were also arrested for allegedly helping him evade the police. Solanki aka Bali's brutally battered body was found in Shukla's office in Andheri on August 20, three days after he had gone missing.
